rv.t: 6-7 hours of gameplay for me to pickup ALL balls while taking my time and finding collectibles. Fair price for that length of a game. Works well no crashes. Fun gameplay loop and concept. Upgrades were nice. 3 modes to choose. …

If the jumpscare guy pesters you too much, pretend you're the Finnish janitor from Control and charge at him with a broom. P.S. If you have balls stuck in a wall, put the ball vacuum next to it, it'll suck them out.
